title: Rust Announce signing omits canonical domain-separated transcript and app length
description: Rust lichen-core Announce::write_signed_data and lichen-node scheduler/tests still construct legacy IID||pubkey||seq||channel||app transcripts. Canonical cross-implementation transcript is LICHEN-ANNOUNCE-v1\0 || IID8 || pubkey32 || seq_u16be || rx_channel_u8 || app_len_u16be || app. Legacy signing permits cross-protocol ambiguity and fails stabilized announce_signed_data.json vectors. Update production builders/verifiers and vector tests consistently.
